geometry.layout: One outer border wraps label and value. Label stays inside; stack gap is between fields, not within a field.

states.label: 12px/16px upper
states.value: placeholder 16px/24px below even when not focused

constraints: Do not place label as external text above field
Do not confuse total legacy source 68px block including helper with component height 54px
Error message stays associated with the field and doesn't change the 54px base geometry
